item.title: Panels endorse master plan to rebuild Cubberley
item.description: Plans for the renovation of the bustling but dilapidated Cubberley Community Center are one step closer to final approval after an intensive review session before Palo Alto’s planning commissioners and architectural board members on Wednesday night. item.title: Inside a professional designer’s own kitchen remodel
item.description: Palo Alto homeowner Gloria Carlson didn’t just remodel her 1950s kitchen — she reimagined it with the precision of a seasoned interior designer. Her first renovation in 2001 inspired a career change from technical speech researcher to certified designer, and now, two decades later, she and her husband, Steve, set out to transform the space again. The post Inside a professional designer’s own kitchen remodel appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Guest Opinion: Closing the Churchill crossing would save lives
item.description: Despite calls to install a net from the year the Golden Gate Bridge opened in 1937, it took until 2024, thousands of lost lives later, for San Francisco to install one. We have an awful truth to face: The Palo Alto train tracks have become our Golden Gate Bridge. The post Guest Opinion: Closing the Churchill crossing would save lives appeared first on Palo Alto Online.
